title: Butler Rededicates Memorial Honoring BUPD Officer James L. Davis Jr.
summary_en: Twenty-two years after Butler University Police Officer James L. Davis Jr. was killed in the line of duty, members of the Butler and Indianapolis law enforcement communities gathered to make sure his service is not forgotten. A replacement memorial sign honoring Davis was dedicated on September 24 near the intersection of 49th Street and Rookwood…
author: Katie Palmer Wharton '14
